reason: The README clearly describes a WebUI plugin for selecting, dragging, sending, and managing multimedia files and folders as workspace attachments, with confirmed cleanup of its own attachment directories.

summaries.zh: 为DSH WebUI提供文件和文件夹选择、拖放发送及工作区附件管理功能。
summaries.en: Adds file and folder selection, drag-and-drop sending, and workspace attachment management to the DSH WebUI.

capabilities: Provides file and folder selection in the WebUI composer
Copies user-selected resources into the active Agent workspace when sent
Allows confirmed cleanup of plugin-owned attachment directories
Uses a same-origin Host HTTP route for attachment handling
